about: Help-desk questions grouped by intent: every phrasing of one intent has the same answer. near_misses pairs intents whose questions look alike but whose answers differ; serving one for the other is a false hit. Used by scripts/measure_cache.py (the threshold trade-off) and evals/replay.py (the cache replay). Written for this project; the answers are in corpus/.
